notes: Highest-complexity interior RP spec. 80 tasks across 8 modules — 75 TSK_CBRP_* + 5 shared TSK_RRP_*. Combined prime+finish for previously painted or factory-finished cabinets in occupied homes. 4 paintable items (door EA, drawer EA, frame SF, interior SF conditional). Double-dimension primer routing (condition + factory finish type). Thermofoil go/no-go gate. Kitchen grease degreasing mandatory. Post-primer adhesion test quality gate. 10 protection zones (highest of any interior RP spec). 5 modifiers (condition_scale, door_style, quality_tier, height, kitchen_complexity). Two-mobilization workflow (paint + cure + reinstall).
